patch.scope: Mobile UX optimization with progressive disclosure; no broad visual redesign.
changes: The mobile Companion now opens with the conversation, quick starts and composer as the primary layer.
Public profile links, privacy context and workflow tools moved into an explicit Info & tools drawer on mobile.
The first assistant message was shortened in Hebrew, English and Russian.
The mobile launcher now clears the bottom navigation dock and iOS safe area.
Mobile controls use touch-friendly sizing and the composer keeps a 16px text size to avoid iOS focus zoom.
Desktop information structure remains expanded and unchanged.
HTML, runtime health and release metadata share one build marker.
The Hebrew mobile sanity test now uses the canonical lang=he parameter.

source_control.note: This receipt records the verified AppDeploy runtime patch. It does not claim that the full AppDeploy source snapshot has been exported into GitHub.
